Background checks; annual and role-based training
Control owners named in the common control catalog; performance objectives include security duties
Inventory of client tenants, data stores, and integrations

control_description: Service objectives and risk tolerance set in the group and division registers

Release reviews for new features and new client integrations

Findings tracked in the POA&M with owners and dates; reported to the board risk committee

control_description: Controls selected from the P01 risks and mapped to SP 800-53 (P02)

topic_label: Protection against threats from outside boundaries
control_description: Hub firewall, web application firewall, and landing-zone guardrails (P07 SC-7 satisfied)

topic_label: Restriction of data transmission and movement
control_description: Client data exports only through client-initiated downloads; TLS everywhere

topic_label: Prevention and detection of unauthorized or malicious software
control_description: EDR on all managed endpoints and servers; email security (SYS-G2, SYS-G5)

topic_label: Detection of configuration changes and vulnerabilities
control_description: Container and dependency scanning in the release pipeline; monthly external scan

topic_label: Monitoring for anomalies and security events
control_description: Service logs in the group SIEM
SOC triage and escalation using one group severity scale (POL-03 4.2)
Group incident response (POL-03) with digital twin client notice steps in the notification matrix
Restore from provider backups
Code review and automated tests for every release
gap: Tenant isolation tests are not part of every release (P01 AE-008)
remediation: Isolation test suite in every release
